functions.name: buildDockerImage
functions.description: Build, tag et push une image Docker vers le registre avec gestion du cache BuildKit et multi-platform.
functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
IMAGE_NAME="${1}"
TAG="${2:-latest}"
DOCKERFILE="${3:-./Dockerfile}"
PLATFORM="${4:-linux/amd64,linux/arm64}"
REGISTRY="${5:-$DOCKER_REGISTRY}"
FULL_TAG="${REGISTRY}/${IMAGE_NAME}:${TAG}"
SHA_TAG="${REGISTRY}/${IMAGE_NAME}:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'latest')"
echo "🐳 Build: ${FULL_TAG}"
BUILDKIT=1 docker buildx build \
  --platform "${PLATFORM}" \
  --file "${DOCKERFILE}" \
  --tag "${FULL_TAG}" \
  --tag "${SHA_TAG}" \
  --cache-from "type=registry,ref=${FULL_TAG}" \
  --cache-to "type=inline" \
  --push \
  .
echo "✅ Image pushée: ${FULL_TAG}"

functions.name: dockerComposeUp
functions.description: Lance un stack Docker Compose en mode détaché avec rebuild automatique et health check.
functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
COMPOSE_FILE="${1:-docker-compose.yml}"
ENV_FILE="${2:-.env}"
SERVICES="${3:-}"
echo "🚀 Docker Compose Up: ${COMPOSE_FILE}"
docker compose \
  --file "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  --env-file "${ENV_FILE}" \
  up --detach --build --remove-orphans ${SERVICES}
echo "⏳ Attente health checks..."
MAX_WAIT=60; ELAPSED=0
while [ $ELAPSED -lt $MAX_WAIT ]; do
  UNHEALTHY=$(docker compose ps --format json | python3 -c "import sys,json; data=[json.loads(l) for l in sys.stdin]; print(len([s for s in data if s.get('Health') not in ['healthy','']]))" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  [ "$UNHEALTHY" = "0" ] && echo "✅ Tous les services sont healthy" && exit 0
  sleep 5; ELAPSED=$((ELAPSED+5))
done
echo "⚠️ Timeout health check" && exit 1

functions.name: scanDockerVulnerabilities
functions.description: Scanne une image Docker pour les vulnérabilités CVE via Trivy et génère un rapport JSON.
functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
IMAGE="${1}"
SEVERITY="${2:-CRITICAL,HIGH}"
OUTPUT="${3:-trivy-report.json}"
echo "🔍 Scan CVE: ${IMAGE}"
if ! command -v trivy &>/dev/null; then
  curl -sfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aquasecurity/trivy/main/contrib/install.sh | sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin
fi
trivy image \
  --severity "${SEVERITY}" \
  --format json \
  --output "${OUTPUT}" \
  --exit-code 0 \
  "${IMAGE}"
CRITICAL=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('${OUTPUT}')); print(sum(1 for r in d.get('Results',[]) for v in r.get('Vulnerabilities',[]) if v.get('Severity')=='CRITICAL'))" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
echo "📊 Rapport: ${OUTPUT} | CRITICAL: ${CRITICAL}"
[ "${CRITICAL}" -gt 0 ] && echo "🚨 ${CRITICAL} vulnérabilités critiques trouvées!" || echo "✅ Aucune vulnérabilité critique"

functions.name: k8sApplyManifest
functions.description: Applique un manifest Kubernetes, attend le rollout et vérifie la santé des pods.

parameters.name: MANIFEST
parameters.description: Chemin YAML ou URL du manifest

functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
MANIFEST="${1}"
NAMESPACE="${2:-$K8S_NAMESPACE}"
TIMEOUT="${3:-5m}"
echo "☸️ Apply manifest: ${MANIFEST} → namespace/${NAMESPACE}"
kubectl apply -f "${MANIFEST}" --namespace="${NAMESPACE}"
DEPLOYMENTS=$(kubectl get deployments -n "${NAMESPACE}" -o name 2>/dev/null)
for DEP in $DEPLOYMENTS; do
  echo "⏳ Rollout: ${DEP}..."
  kubectl rollout status "${DEP}" --namespace="${NAMESPACE}" --timeout="${TIMEOUT}"
done
echo "🔍 Statut pods:"
kubectl get pods --namespace="${NAMESPACE}" --sort-by='.metadata.creationTimestamp'
echo "✅ Déploiement K8s terminé"

functions.name: k8sScaleDeployment
functions.description: Scale un déploiement Kubernetes à un nombre de replicas et attend la stabilisation.
functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
DEPLOYMENT="${1}"
REPLICAS="${2}"
NAMESPACE="${3:-$K8S_NAMESPACE}"
echo "📈 Scale ${DEPLOYMENT} → ${REPLICAS} replicas"
kubectl scale deployment "${DEPLOYMENT}" \
  --replicas="${REPLICAS}" \
  --namespace="${NAMESPACE}"
kubectl rollout status deployment/"${DEPLOYMENT}" \
  --namespace="${NAMESPACE}" \
  --timeout=3m
READY=$(kubectl get deployment "${DEPLOYMENT}" -n "${NAMESPACE}" -o jsonpath='{.status.readyReplicas}')
echo "✅ ${DEPLOYMENT}: ${READY}/${REPLICAS} replicas ready"

functions.name: k8sGetPodLogs
functions.description: Récupère les logs d'un pod K8s avec filtre sur les erreurs et export fichier optionnel.

parameters.name: POD_SELECTOR
parameters.description: Label selector (ex: app=api) ou nom de pod exact

functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
SELECTOR="${1}"
NAMESPACE="${2:-$K8S_NAMESPACE}"
SINCE="${3:-1h}"
OUTPUT="${4:-}"
if echo "${SELECTOR}" | grep -q '='; then
  KUBECTL_ARGS="--selector=${SELECTOR}"
else
  KUBECTL_ARGS="${SELECTOR}"
fi
CMD="kubectl logs ${KUBECTL_ARGS} -n ${NAMESPACE} --since=${SINCE} --all-containers=true --prefix=true"
if [ -n "${OUTPUT}" ]; then
  $CMD | tee "${OUTPUT}"
  echo "📄 Logs sauvegardés: ${OUTPUT}"
else
  $CMD
fi

functions.name: helmDeploy
functions.description: Déploie ou met à jour un chart Helm avec values file et atomic rollback automatique.
functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
RELEASE="${1}"; CHART="${2}"
VALUES="${3:-values.yaml}"; NS="${4:-$K8S_NAMESPACE}"; EXTRA="${5:-}"
echo "⚓ Helm upgrade/install: ${RELEASE} (${CHART}) → ${NS}"
helm upgrade --install "${RELEASE}" "${CHART}" \
  --namespace "${NS}" \
  --create-namespace \
  --values "${VALUES}" \
  --atomic \
  --cleanup-on-fail \
  --timeout 5m \
  --history-max 5 \
  ${EXTRA}
echo "✅ Release Helm: ${RELEASE} v$(helm list -n ${NS} -f ${RELEASE} -o json | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]['chart'])" 2>/dev/null)"

functions.name: terraformApply
functions.description: Initialise, plan et applique de l'IaC Terraform avec backend remote et workspace.
functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${1}"; VAR_FILE="${2:-terraform.tfvars}"
AUTO_APPROVE="${3:-false}"; BACKEND="${4:-$TERRAFORM_BACKEND_BUCKET}"
echo "🏗️ Terraform: workspace=${WORKSPACE}"
terraform init \
  -backend-config="bucket=${BACKEND}" \
  -backend-config="key=${WORKSPACE}/terraform.tfstate" \
  -reconfigure -input=false
terraform workspace select "${WORKSPACE}" 2>/dev/null || terraform workspace new "${WORKSPACE}"
terraform validate
terraform plan -var-file="${VAR_FILE}" -detailed-exitcode -out=tfplan || EXIT=$?
if [ "${EXIT:-0}" -eq 0 ]; then echo "✅ Aucun changement"; exit 0; fi
if [ "${AUTO_APPROVE}" = "true" ]; then
  terraform apply tfplan && echo "✅ Infrastructure appliquée"
else
  echo "📋 Plan généré — appliquer manuellement: terraform apply tfplan"
fi

functions.name: ansiblePlaybook
functions.description: Exécute un playbook Ansible avec inventaire dynamique, vault et gestion des tags.
functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
PLAYBOOK="${1}"; INVENTORY="${2:-inventory/}"
TAGS="${3:-}"; EXTRA="${4:-{}}"; CHECK="${5:-false}"
echo "📦 Ansible: ${PLAYBOOK}"
ARGS="--inventory ${INVENTORY} --extra-vars '${EXTRA}'"
[ -n "${TAGS}" ] && ARGS="${ARGS} --tags ${TAGS}"
[ "${CHECK}" = "true" ] && ARGS="${ARGS} --check --diff"
[ -f ".vault-pass" ] && ARGS="${ARGS} --vault-password-file .vault-pass"
ANSIBLE_STDOUT_CALLBACK=yaml \
ANSIBLE_HOST_KEY_CHECKING=False \
ansible-playbook ${PLAYBOOK} ${ARGS} -v
echo "✅ Playbook terminé: ${PLAYBOOK}"

functions.name: setupGitHubActionsPipeline
functions.description: Template GitHub Actions complet : lint, test, build Docker, scan sécurité, déploiement K8s avec environments et approvals.
functions.source:
name: CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}

jobs:
  lint-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: '20', cache: 'npm' }
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run test:coverage
      - uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4

  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint-and-test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          scan-type: 'fs'
          scan-ref: '.'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy.sarif'
      - uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        with: { sarif_file: 'trivy.sarif' }

  build-and-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: security-scan
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    outputs:
      image-tag: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
      image-digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
          tags: |
            type=sha,prefix=sha-
            type=raw,value=latest
      - id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

  deploy-staging:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-and-push
    environment: staging
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v3
      - run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG }}" | base64 -d > kubeconfig.yaml
          export KUBECONFIG=kubeconfig.yaml
          kubectl set image deployment/api api=${{ needs.build-and-push.outputs.image-tag }} -n staging
          kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n staging --timeout=5m

  deploy-production:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: deploy-staging
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v3
      - run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG }}" | base64 -d > kubeconfig.yaml
          export KUBECONFIG=kubeconfig.yaml
          kubectl set image deployment/api api=${{ needs.build-and-push.outputs.image-tag }} -n production
          kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n production --timeout=5m

functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH="${1}"; PR_TITLE="${2:-}"; BASE="${3:-main}"
git fetch origin
git checkout "${BASE}"
git pull origin "${BASE}"
git checkout -b "${BRANCH}"
git push -u origin "${BRANCH}"
echo "🌿 Branche créée et pushée: ${BRANCH}"
if [ -n "${PR_TITLE}" ] && command -v gh &>/dev/null; then
  gh pr create \
    --title "${PR_TITLE}" \
    --base "${BASE}" \
    --head "${BRANCH}" \
    --body "$(cat .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md 2>/dev/null || echo 'PR auto-générée')" \

fi

functions.name: gitTagAndRelease
functions.description: Crée un tag Git sémantique, génère un changelog et publie une release GitHub.
functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
VERSION="${1}"; NOTES="${2:-}"
git tag -a "${VERSION}" -m "Release ${VERSION}"
git push origin "${VERSION}"
echo "🏷️ Tag créé: ${VERSION}"
if command -v gh &>/dev/null; then
  if [ -z "${NOTES}" ]; then
    NOTES=$(git log $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 HEAD~1 2>/dev/null || echo '')..HEAD --pretty=format:'- %s (%an)' 2>/dev/null | head -30)
  fi
  gh release create "${VERSION}" \
    --title "Release ${VERSION}" \
    --notes "${NOTES}" \
    --latest
  echo "🚀 Release GitHub publiée: ${VERSION}"
fi

functions.name: setupPreCommitHooks
functions.description: Installe et configure les git hooks pre-commit (lint, test, secret scanning) via Husky.
functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
echo "🪝 Configuration Husky + lint-staged"
npm install --save-dev husky lint-staged @commitlint/cli @commitlint/config-conventional
npx husky init
# Pre-commit: lint et format
cat > .husky/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
npx lint-staged
EOF
# Commit-msg: conventional commits
cat > .husky/commit-msg << 'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
npx --no -- commitlint --edit $1
EOF
# Détection secrets
cat > .husky/pre-push << 'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
if command -v gitleaks &>/dev/null; then gitleaks protect --staged; fi
EOF
chmod +x .husky/pre-commit .husky/commit-msg .husky/pre-push
cat >> package.json << 'EOF'
,"lint-staged": {"*.{js,ts,tsx}": ["eslint --fix","prettier --write"],"*.{json,md,yml}": ["prettier --write"]}
EOF
echo "✅ Husky hooks installés"

functions.name: createFastAPIApp
functions.description: Template FastAPI production avec JWT auth, rate limiting, CORS, Prometheus metrics, lifespan et Pydantic v2.
functions.source:
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, Request, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.middleware.gzip import GZipMiddleware
from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
from prometheus_client import Counter, Histogram, generate_latest, CONTENT_TYPE_LATEST
from starlette.responses import Response
from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings
import redis.asyncio as aioredis
import jwt, time, logging
from typing import Optional

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format='%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s %(message)s')
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class Settings(BaseSettings):
    jwt_secret: str
    redis_url: str = 'redis://localhost:6379'
    cors_origins: list[str] = ['http://localhost:3000']
    class Config: env_file = '.env'

settings = Settings()
redis_client: aioredis.Redis = None

# Métriques Prometheus
requests_total = Counter('http_requests_total', 'Total HTTP requests', ['method', 'endpoint', 'status'])
request_duration = Histogram('http_request_duration_seconds', 'HTTP request duration', ['method', 'endpoint'])

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    global redis_client
    redis_client = await aioredis.from_url(settings.redis_url, decode_responses=True)
    logger.info('Redis connecté')
    yield
    await redis_client.aclose()
    logger.info('Redis fermé')

app = FastAPI(title='MyApp API', version='1.0.0', docs_url='/docs', redoc_url=None, lifespan=lifespan)
app.add_middleware(GZipMiddleware, minimum_size=1000)
app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=settings.cors_origins, allow_credentials=True, allow_methods=['*'], allow_headers=['*'])

security = HTTPBearer()

@app.middleware('http')
async def metrics_middleware(request: Request, call_next):
    start = time.time()
    response = await call_next(request)
    duration = time.time() - start
    requests_total.labels(request.method, request.url.path, response.status_code).inc()
    request_duration.labels(request.method, request.url.path).observe(duration)
    return response

def verify_token(credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security)):
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(credentials.credentials, settings.jwt_secret, algorithms=['HS256'])
        return payload
    except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail='Token expiré')
    except jwt.InvalidTokenError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail='Token invalide')

@app.get('/health')
async def health(): return {'status': 'ok', 'timestamp': time.time()}

@app.get('/metrics')
async def metrics(): return Response(generate_latest(), media_type=CONTENT_TYPE_LATEST)

@app.get('/me', dependencies=[Depends(verify_token)])
async def get_me(payload: dict = Depends(verify_token)): return {'user': payload}

functions.name: runCypressE2E
functions.description: Lance les tests E2E Cypress en mode headless avec report JUnit et screenshots sur failure.
functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
SPEC="${1:-cypress/e2e/**/*.cy.ts}"
BASE_URL="${2:-http://localhost:3000}"
BROWSER="${3:-chrome}"
mkdir -p cypress/results cypress/screenshots
echo "🧪 Tests E2E Cypress | URL: ${BASE_URL}"
npx cypress run \
  --spec "${SPEC}" \
  --browser "${BROWSER}" \
  --headless \
  --config baseUrl="${BASE_URL}" \
  --reporter junit \
  --reporter-options "mochaFile=cypress/results/results-[hash].xml,toConsole=true"
EXIT=$?
if [ $EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
  SCREENSHOTS=$(find cypress/screenshots -name '*.png' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
  echo "❌ Tests échoués | ${SCREENSHOTS} screenshot(s) capturé(s)"
  exit $EXIT
fi
echo "✅ Tous les tests E2E passent"

#!/bin/bash

  npx vitest --watch

    --coverage \
    --coverage.provider=v8 \
    --coverage.reporter=lcov \
    --coverage.reporter=text \
    --coverage.thresholds.lines=${THRESHOLD} \

    --coverage.thresholds.branches=${THRESHOLD} \
    --reporter=junit \
    --outputFile=test-results.xml

fi

functions.description: Lance un test de charge k6 avec scénarios de montée en charge progressive et seuils SLA.
functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
SCRIPT="${1:-loadtest.js}"
VUS="${2:-50}"
DURATION="${3:-5m}"
TARGET_URL="${4}"
echo "⚡ Load test k6 | VUs: ${VUS} | Durée: ${DURATION}"
if ! command -v k6 &>/dev/null; then
  curl -fsSL https://dl.k6.io/key.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/k6-archive-keyring.gpg
  echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/k6-archive-keyring.gpg] https://dl.k6.io/deb stable main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/k6.list
  sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y k6
fi
k6 run \
  --vus="${VUS}" \
  --duration="${DURATION}" \
  --env TARGET_URL="${TARGET_URL}" \
  --out json=k6-results.json \
  --summary-export=k6-summary.json \
  "${SCRIPT}"
echo "📊 Résultats: k6-summary.json"

functions.name: setupDatabaseMigrations
functions.description: Exécute les migrations de base de données avec Flyway ou Prisma Migrate avec rollback sécurisé.
functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
TOOL="${1:-prisma}"
ENV="${2:-production}"
DRY_RUN="${3:-false}"
echo "🗃️ Migrations DB | Tool: ${TOOL} | Env: ${ENV}"
case "${TOOL}" in
  prisma)
    if [ "${DRY_RUN}" = "true" ]; then
      npx prisma migrate diff --preview-feature
    else
      npx prisma migrate deploy
      npx prisma generate
      echo "✅ Migrations Prisma appliquées"
    fi
    ;;
  flyway)
    FLYWAY_ARGS="-url=${DATABASE_URL} -locations=filesystem:db/migrations"
    [ "${DRY_RUN}" = "true" ] && flyway info ${FLYWAY_ARGS} || flyway migrate ${FLYWAY_ARGS}
    ;;
  knex)
    [ "${DRY_RUN}" = "true" ] && npx knex migrate:status || npx knex migrate:latest
    ;;
  drizzle)
    [ "${DRY_RUN}" = "true" ] && npx drizzle-kit check || npx drizzle-kit migrate
    ;;
  *) echo "❌ Outil inconnu: ${TOOL}"; exit 1 ;;
esac

functions.name: configureArgoCD
functions.description: Manifest ArgoCD Application pour GitOps déploiement continu avec sync automatique et health checks.
functions.source:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: myapp-production
  namespace: argocd
  annotations:
    notifications.argoproj.io/subscribe.on-sync-succeeded.slack: devops-alerts
    notifications.argoproj.io/subscribe.on-sync-failed.slack: devops-alerts
spec:
  project: default
  source:
    repoURL: https://github.com/myorg/myapp.git
    targetRevision: main
    path: k8s/overlays/production
    kustomize:
      images:
        - ghcr.io/myorg/myapp:sha-latest
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: production
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      prune: true
      selfHeal: true
      allowEmpty: false
    syncOptions:
      - CreateNamespace=true
      - PrunePropagationPolicy=foreground
      - ServerSideApply=true
    retry:
      limit: 5
      backoff:
        duration: 5s
        factor: 2
        maxDuration: 3m
  revisionHistoryLimit: 10
  ignoreDifferences:
    - group: apps
      kind: Deployment
      jsonPointers:
        - /spec/replicas

functions.name: setupKustomizeOverlays
functions.description: Génère la structure Kustomize base/overlays pour multi-environnements K8s (dev/staging/prod).
functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
APP="${1}"; IMAGE="${2}"
mkdir -p k8s/{base,overlays/{development,staging,production}}
# Base deployment
cat > k8s/base/deployment.yaml << EOF
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ${APP}
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ${APP}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ${APP}
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ${APP}
        image: ${IMAGE}
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3000
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 3000
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /ready
            port: 3000
EOF
# Base kustomization
cat > k8s/base/kustomization.yaml << EOF
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
- deployment.yaml
- service.yaml
EOF
# Production overlay
cat > k8s/overlays/production/kustomization.yaml << EOF
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
bases:
- ../../base
patches:
- target:
    kind: Deployment
  patch: |-
    - op: replace
      path: /spec/replicas
      value: 3
namePrefix: prod-
EOF
echo "✅ Structure Kustomize générée pour ${APP}"

functions.name: setupGitLabCIPipeline
functions.description: Pipeline GitLab CI/CD complet avec stages parallèles, règles, cache et déploiement blue-green.
functions.source:
stages:
  - validate
  - test
  - build
  - security
  - deploy-staging
  - deploy-production

variables:
  DOCKER_DRIVER: overlay2
  DOCKER_BUILDKIT: "1"
  IMAGE_TAG: $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA

cache:
  key:
    files: [package-lock.json]
  paths: [node_modules/]

lint:
  stage: validate
  image: node:20-alpine
  script:
    - npm ci --cache .npm --prefer-offline
    - npm run lint
    - npm run type-check
  rules:
    - if: $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH

unit-tests:
  stage: test
  image: node:20-alpine
  services:
    - redis:7-alpine
  script:
    - npm ci
    - npm run test:coverage
  coverage: '/Lines\s*:\s*(\d+\.?\d*)%/'
  artifacts:
    reports:
      junit: junit.xml
      coverage_report:
        coverage_format: cobertura
        path: coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml

build-image:
  stage: build
  image: docker:24
  services: [docker:24-dind]
  before_script:
    - docker login -u $CI_REGISTRY_USER -p $CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD $CI_REGISTRY
  script:
    - docker buildx build --push --tag $IMAGE_TAG --cache-from $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:latest .
    - docker tag $IMAGE_TAG $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:latest
    - docker push $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:latest
  only: [main, develop]

trivy-scan:
  stage: security
  image: aquasec/trivy:latest
  script:
    - trivy image --exit-code 0 --severity CRITICAL,HIGH --format sarif -o gl-sast-report.json $IMAGE_TAG
  artifacts:
    reports:
      sast: gl-sast-report.json

deploy-staging:
  stage: deploy-staging
  image: bitnami/kubectl:latest
  environment: { name: staging, url: https://staging.myapp.io }
  script:
    - kubectl set image deployment/api api=$IMAGE_TAG -n staging
    - kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n staging --timeout=5m
  only: [develop]

deploy-production:
  stage: deploy-production
  image: bitnami/kubectl:latest
  environment: { name: production, url: https://myapp.io }
  when: manual
  script:
    - kubectl set image deployment/api api=$IMAGE_TAG -n production
    - kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n production --timeout=5m
  only: [main]

functions.name: encryptEnvFile
functions.description: Chiffre/déchiffre un fichier .env avec GPG ou SOPS pour stockage sécurisé en dépôt Git.
functions.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
ACTION="${1}"; FILE="${2:-.env}"; TOOL="${3:-sops}"
if [ "${TOOL}" = "sops" ]; then
  case "${ACTION}" in
    encrypt)
      sops --encrypt --in-place "${FILE}"
      echo "🔐 ${FILE} chiffré avec SOPS"
      ;;
    decrypt)
      sops --decrypt "${FILE}" > "${FILE}.decrypted"
      echo "🔓 ${FILE} déchiffré → ${FILE}.decrypted"
      ;;
  esac
elif [ "${TOOL}" = "gpg" ]; then
  case "${ACTION}" in
    encrypt)
      gpg --symmetric --cipher-algo AES256 --output "${FILE}.gpg" "${FILE}"
      echo "🔐 ${FILE}.gpg créé"
      ;;
    decrypt)
      gpg --quiet --output "${FILE}.decrypted" --decrypt "${FILE}.gpg"
      echo "🔓 ${FILE} déchiffré"
      ;;
  esac
fi
